segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (including one describing hormonal blemishes and one with oily hypertension skin per an esthetician) report brightening, softening and improved clarity without added greasiness.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, some in their 60s, describe the mask as hydrating, soft and non-stripping, though one finds a separate microdermabrasion scrub too harsh for her dry skin by comparison.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with combination acne-prone skin, report no breakouts or irritation and supple, smooth skin after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers form the largest group and overwhelmingly report a warming tingle with no irritation, redness that fades quickly, or softer smoother skin, though a few shorten the recommended wear time as a precaution and one reports an initial 'sensation' during application.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to late 60s describe smoother, firmer-looking, more luminous skin and reduced fine lines or pore appearance after regular use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother, firmer, more luminous-looking skin and a temporary reduction in the appearance of fine lines; no reviewer reports it failing to help with aging concerns.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including one who used it to recover from a drying product, report the mask leaves skin hydrated and soft rather than tight or dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with reactive or redness-prone skin note the mask causes a normal, short-lived pink flush after use but not lasting irritation or heat in the skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically used the mask on an already-compromised, over-dried barrier and reports it restored moisture after a single use.
concerns.spots: An esthetician-formatted review and a mature-skin reviewer suggest the mask may help fade acne marks over time, though this is based on limited use and not confirmed by most reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone, hormonal or combination-acne skin report no new breakouts and some clearing of blemishes within a few uses; no reviewer reports the mask causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask leaves their skin brighter and softened rather than shinier or greasier.
